title: Chapter Plan
description: Multi-page narrative and layout plan for a contiguous story arc. Authored by AI or human, reviewed and approved before production runs.

chapter_id.description: Unique chapter number within the project. Assigned by the author.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about this chapter's narrative arc.

page_id.description: Unique page identifier in {chapter_id}_{page_within_chapter} format. E.g. 2_3 for chapter 2, page 3.

layout.description: References a layout file by layout_id. The plan parser resolves this to pixel dimensions.

continuity.description: Page-level continuity state. Contains only fields that cannot be derived from the panel blocks.

time_of_day.description: E.g. dawn, morning, midday, afternoon, dusk, night.

panels.description: Ordered list of panel specifications. Count must match the panel count in the referenced layout.

position.description: Panel position within the page. Must correspond to a position defined in the referenced layout.

characters.description: character_ids of characters present in this panel. Used by the compiler to select reference images.

environment.description: environment_id for the location depicted in this panel.

shot_type.description: Camera framing. Overrides the layout's composition_hint.

mood.description: Emotional register of this panel. Influences lighting and composition tokens in the compiled prompt.

description.description: Prose description of what is depicted in this panel. Primary creative input to the prompt compiler.
